youtube.title: The Titanic's Lookouts Had No Binoculars. The Key Left the Ship Before It Sailed.
youtube.description:
Second Officer David Blair was replaced in a last-minute crew change before the Titanic's maiden voyage. He left the ship in Southampton with a small key in his pocket, believed to open the crow's nest binoculars locker. Lookout Fred Fleet later told the inquiry binoculars would have let them see the iceberg sooner. Some experts doubt it would have mattered on a moonless night. In 2007, the key sold at auction for £90,000.

📂 Case File #049: The Titanic Key
